title: Change Desk — Post-deployment Upgrades with Backup and Rollback
governing_principle: When Vyomaraj is deployed and live in the market, the owner can give instructions for any change, fix or upgrade. Vyomaraj and Jarvis align internally with ShriYantra, talk to each other and to all the AI agents, make the changes with full version control, test everything separately, check the test results, and upgrade themselves — with the owner's permission. If anything goes wrong, the backup plan engages immediately: roll back the changes and continue with the current version, with no business impact.

policy.authority: Owner instructions only, through ShriYantra (the authority root). Arena executes approved tasks; it is not the owner or the authority root.
policy.alignment: Vyomaraj/Bharath (central intelligence) and Jarvis/Laxman (coordination) align with ShriYantra before any change is planned.
policy.agent_coordination: All affected agents are informed and coordinated; no agent changes behaviour silently.
policy.version_control: Every change rides a version-controlled branch and commits; nothing overwrites the running version directly.
policy.separate_testing: Changes are tested separately from the running business; test results are checked before any upgrade.
policy.permission_gate: PENDING_OWNER_PERMISSION — the owner approves the upgrade before it is applied.
policy.zero_business_impact: The running business is not interrupted; if the verification fails, the backup plan engages and the current version continues.
policy.rollback: Backup first, always: the previous version is snapshotted before any upgrade, and rollback restores it without data loss.
policy.no_force: No force-push, no history deletion, no blind two-way overwrite — the same rules as the DR lane.

sample_instructions.instruction: Add Hinglish editions to the comics lane for all future versions.
Fix the nostalgic camera queue so the oldest item is reviewed first.
Upgrade the morning briefing voice with the new family voice pack.

testing_stages.name: offline suite
testing_stages.rule: all unit and integrity tests pass on the change branch

testing_stages.name: separate preview
testing_stages.rule: the change runs on a separate preview, never on the live business

testing_stages.name: verification gate
testing_stages.rule: test results are checked and recorded before the owner is asked for permission

testing_stages.name: post-upgrade verification
testing_stages.rule: after the upgrade, the same checks confirm the business is healthy; any failure engages the backup plan

rollback_plan.backup_first: snapshot the current running version before any upgrade
rollback_plan.action: roll back to the snapshot and continue with the current version
rollback_plan.data: version control retains the full history; no commit is deleted
rollback_plan.business_impact: the running business continues on the current version while the failed change is repaired
